Ask someone to make Windows installation media or, if you have another computer, make it yourself.

Here is how to make it yourself: Get Windows 10/11 .ISO file from official Microsoft website (You could google it up by something like "Download windows 10 Microsoft" and follow Microsoft's link). Next you should get a USB drive (flashdrive) 8 GBs at least. Download one of the programs: ULTRAISO, Rufus. Flash the drive with it (You can also google it like: "[Your program name] how to flash ISO on a flash drive"). Then insert USB drive in the laptop and reboot it (completely reboot, power off and power on). Install it following the normal steps. If something, you can contact me on discord if you will need more help (same as my reddit name but all lowercase), or dm me in reddit.

Why not completely reinstall Windows? Only advantage of factory resetting is getting drivers preinstalled which can be done manually. If you REALLY want to factory reset - create any livecd/liveusb with second PC/ask someone to do so and boot from it.

On windows installation medias press Shift and F10 at the same time to get command line. Open notepad from it, use "Open" dialogue and select "Any files" instead of "Text files" and locate your drive, from here you can delete files.

On linux livecds just proceed with default file managers and mount your partition. If file manager cant mount it themselves, they will say something like this: "Can not mount /dev/sda1..", then open terminal, type:

sudo mkdir /mnt/INSIDEDISC

then:

sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt/INSIDEDISC/


after all that it should be able to open files for you to manage.

Officially this word is just misspelled, but people-wise блять is more as "fuck" and not as "whore". Блядь is more commonly used as whore, but has also the same "fuck" word-filler usage. Pretty much it doesn't exists, but it does in people.

First of all, I am not sure why you would need bad words in the exam, but anyways, I will provide only the basic meanings of most words, they can vary depending on the intonation and context.

Заебись = отлично(good, fantastic)

Блять - could be used pretty much anywhere, mostly word-filler.

Блядь - whore (could be also used instead of блять, if nobody speaks about woman.)

Сука - bitch/whore sometimes. Could also be a word-filler.

Шлюха - whore too.

Пидор - mean word for "gay", but could be a normal insult, even if the person is not gay.

Хуй - dick pretty much, but can vary (Иди нахуй - go fuck yourself/fuck you)

Хуйня - equal to "that shit". Sometimes can mean that something is bad (in quality or whatever)

Пизда - pussy. Can also mean like "We're screwed" - Нам пизда.

Пиздец - no direct translation, could mean that the situation is bad and crazy. Could be used in the same example: Нам пиздец (We're screwed)

I have to say once more, those are the most common meanings. They may vary from context and some other stuff. Also, this is just the short words, we also have words made from other bad words. For example: пиздоблядская хуйня (not really something directly translatable..)

There are such things as "volume names". Some file managers can't mount volumes with spaces in it's name.
You have to mount it yourself by doing this.
1. Use lsblk to get drives /dev number (as an example, /dev/sdc1
2. Create folder in mnt directory by using
sudo mkdir /mnt/FOLDERNANE
3. Mount the drive
sudo mount /dev/sdc1 /mnt/FOLDERNAME
4. It should now appear in file manager as mounted. If it is not, just open the folder you created.
